system: Assign only the missing responsibilities of attached assets in this H3 request. Interpret the complete user request semantically, not from a keyword list. The BOOTS panel shows a close-up of black lace-up leather combat boots with a worn, wet or muddy surface.
The sheet has low-key cinematic lighting, with cool blue-gray night tones, warm amber practical lights in the top panel, and soft directional studio lighting in the turnaround and detail panels.
The visible labels on the sheet read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

The hero environment is a dark volcanic rocky landscape with glowing orange lava fissures in the background, haze, and shallow water reflecting the dragon’s feet.

A panel labeled “CLAW AND FOOT” shows a close view of a scaly foot with prominent curved claws resting on dark rock.
A panel labeled “SCALE DETAIL” shows tightly overlapping dark scales with blue-gray iridescent highlights.
